title.en: Statistical enquiry: primary and secondary data
title.kn: ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ವಿಚಾರಣೆ: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ

hook.en: To know the pocket money of your class, you can ask every classmate. To know the population of Karnataka, you open the Census report. Both are data, but of different kinds.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯ ಜೇಬುಖರ್ಚು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರನ್ನು ಕೇಳಬಹುದು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಜನಗಣತಿ ವರದಿ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಎರಡೂ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ, ಆದರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬಗೆಯವು.

objectives.en: Explain the stages of a statistical enquiry
Name the investigator, enumerator and respondent

body.en: A statistical enquiry is a search for facts using statistical methods. The investigator plans and conducts it, enumerators collect the information, and respondents supply it. Planning decides the object and scope of the enquiry, the statistical unit (e.g. a household), the source of data, the method of collection and the degree of accuracy required.
body.kn: ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳಿಂದ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ. ತನಿಖಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಯೋಜಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಗಣತಿದಾರರು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಉತ್ತರದಾತರು ಮಾಹಿತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಉದ್ದೇಶ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ, ಘಟಕ, ಮೂಲ, ವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಖರತೆಯನ್ನು ಮೊದಲೇ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಬೇಕು.

points.en: Plan: object, scope, unit, source, method, accuracy

narration.en: An enquiry into household spending can collect primary data (your own survey, original and fitted to your purpose, but costly and slow) or use secondary data (already published, cheap and quick, but collected for someone else). The numbers here are illustrative: ₹ 60 and about 25 interviews per enumerator per day for a survey.
narration.kn: ಕುಟುಂಬ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ (ಸ್ವಂತ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ: ಮೂಲ, ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಂದುವುದು, ಆದರೆ ದುಬಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಧಾನ) ಅಥವಾ ದ್ವಿತೀಯಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ (ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಪ್ರಕಟಿತ, ಅಗ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ವೇಗ, ಆದರೆ ಬೇರೆಯವರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ) ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ದೃಷ್ಟಾಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ.

text.en: Secondary data: check who collected it, when and why

tryThis.en: For 2,000 households, how many enumerators keep a survey under 20 days?
tryThis.kn: 2,000 ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ 20 ದಿನದೊಳಗೆ ಮುಗಿಸಲು ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಣತಿದಾರರು ಬೇಕು?

tryThis.en: When is secondary data the sensible choice?

say.en: The investigator plans, the enumerators collect and the respondents answer.
The NSO collects household data itself: for the NSO they are primary data.
A student who reads the NSO report uses the same data second-hand: secondary data.
Same numbers, different users: it depends on who collected them.

narration.en: On the board: Who collects, who uses?.
For the person using the data, are these primary or secondary data?

prompt.en: For the person using the data, are these primary or secondary data?

text.en: A student visits 50 shops on her street and notes the price of milk
A teacher measures the heights of the students in her own class
An NGO interviews farmers about their loans
The Census office counts the houses in every village
A researcher uses Census 2011 population figures
A reporter quotes interest rates from the RBI Bulletin
A firm studies rainfall published by the Meteorological Department
A student takes GDP figures from the Economic Survey

explanation.en: Primary data are collected first-hand by the investigator for his own purpose. Data already collected and published by someone else (Census, RBI, IMD, Economic Survey) are secondary for every other user.

body.en: Primary data are collected for the first time by the investigator for his own purpose: they are original, suit the purpose well, but cost time and money. Secondary data are data already collected by someone else and used by the investigator: cheaper and quicker, but must be used with care. The same data are primary for the agency that collects them and secondary for everyone else.
body.kn: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ: ತನಿಖಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ ಮೂಲ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ: ಬೇರೆಯವರು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ; ಅಗ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಗ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು.

points.en: Primary for one agency, secondary for another

problem.en: Classify as primary or secondary data: (a) A student asks 50 classmates their daily study hours. (b) A teacher uses Census 2011 literacy figures. (c) A researcher uses price data from the RBI Bulletin. (d) The NSO collects data on household spending.

steps.en: (a) The student collects them first-hand: primary.
(b) and (c) were collected by the Census office and the RBI: secondary for the teacher and the researcher.
(d) The NSO collects them itself: primary for the NSO.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify as primary or secondary data: (a) A student asks 50 classmates their daily study hours. (b) A teacher uses Census 2011 literacy figures. (c) A researcher uses price data from the RBI Bulletin. (d) The NSO collects data on household spending.

body.en: Ask: "Who collected these numbers?" If you did, they are primary; if someone else did, they are secondary for you.

narration.en: First-hand or second-hand?. Ask: "Who collected these numbers?" If you did, they are primary; if someone else did, they are secondary for you.

mnemonic.en: I collect → Primary; I collect from print → Secondary

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Primary for the collector, secondary for other users.

homework.en: Distinguish between primary and secondary data (any four points).

narration.en: Recap. An enquiry has an investigator, enumerators and respondents. Plan the object, scope, unit, source, method and accuracy. Primary data are original; secondary data are already collected. Primary for the collector, secondary for other users.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತನಿಖಾಧಿಕಾರಿ, ಗಣತಿದಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತರದಾತರು ಇರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಉದ್ದೇಶ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ, ಘಟಕ, ಮೂಲ, ವಿಧಾನ, ನಿಖರತೆಯನ್ನು ಯೋಜಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮೂಲ; ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ್ದು. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಕನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ, ಇತರರಿಗೆ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ.
